quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Spacious"? (a wide-open gymnasium vs. a closet stuffed with boxes)
quests.question: Spacious
quests.hint: Think about how a stadium feels compared to the inside of a small closet. What's the opposite of "Spacious"?
quests.explanation: "Spacious" means having plenty of open room. "Cramped" means having barely any room to move. Since those are completely different, Cramped is the opposite of Spacious!
quests.funFact: Some spacious airplane hangars are big enough to fit several jumbo jets at once!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Elevate"? (a crane lifting a piano up to a window vs. workers setting it back down)
quests.question: Elevate
quests.hint: Think about what a hospital bed does when a nurse presses the up button. What's the opposite of "Elevate"?
quests.explanation: "Elevate" means to raise something higher. "Lower" means to bring something down. Since those are completely different, Lower is the opposite of Elevate!
quests.funFact: Adjustable desks let you elevate them so you can even work standing up!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Success"? (crossing the finish line to loud cheers vs. tripping just before the finish)
quests.question: Success
quests.hint: Think about what a scientist calls it when an experiment finally works. What's the opposite of "Success"?
quests.explanation: "Success" means achieving what you were trying to do. "Failure" means not achieving what you were trying to do. Since those are completely different, Failure is the opposite of Success!
quests.funFact: Many inventors say their biggest success came right after their biggest failure!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Skilled"? (a juggler tossing five balls smoothly vs. someone tripping over their own shoelaces)
quests.question: Skilled
quests.hint: Think about how a professional skater moves compared to someone on ice for the first time. What's the opposite of "Skilled"?
quests.explanation: "Skilled" means very good at doing something, from lots of practice. "Clumsy" means awkward and prone to little accidents. Since those are completely different, Clumsy is the opposite of Skilled!
quests.funFact: Even the most skilled jugglers were once clumsy the very first time they tried!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Accelerate"? (a race car speeding off the starting line vs. a car easing to a stop at a light)
quests.question: Accelerate
quests.hint: Think about what a driver's foot does to the gas pedal to go faster. What's the opposite of "Accelerate"?
quests.explanation: "Accelerate" means to speed up. "Decelerate" means to slow down. Since those are completely different, Decelerate is the opposite of Accelerate!
quests.funFact: Roller coasters accelerate fastest right after the very first big drop!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Ascend"? (a climber scaling up a mountain vs. a hiker heading back down the trail)
quests.question: Ascend
quests.hint: Think about what an elevator button with an up arrow makes the elevator do. What's the opposite of "Ascend"?
quests.explanation: "Ascend" means to move upward, step by step. "Descend" means to move downward, step by step. Since those are completely different, Descend is the opposite of Ascend!
quests.funFact: Mountain climbers often ascend very slowly to let their bodies adjust to the thin air!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Murmur"? (a hushed murmur passed between friends vs. a lion's roar echoing for miles)
quests.question: Murmur
quests.hint: Think about the sound a crowd makes right before an exciting announcement. What's the opposite of "Murmur"?
quests.explanation: "Murmur" means to speak very softly and low. "Roar" means to make a huge, powerful sound. Since those are completely different, Roar is the opposite of Murmur!
quests.funFact: A lion's roar can be heard by other lions up to five miles away!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Praise"? (a teacher circling 'great work!' on a paper vs. a teacher listing every mistake)
quests.question: Praise
quests.hint: Think about what a proud coach says after a great play. What's the opposite of "Praise"?
quests.explanation: "Praise" means to say something is done really well. "Criticize" means to point out what is done poorly. Since those are completely different, Criticize is the opposite of Praise!
quests.funFact: Helpful criticism, said kindly, can actually help someone improve even faster!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Encourage"? (a coach cheering 'you can do it!' vs. words that make someone want to give up)
quests.question: Encourage
quests.hint: Think about what a good coach shouts from the sidelines during a tough game. What's the opposite of "Encourage"?
quests.explanation: "Encourage" means to give someone confidence to keep trying. "Discourage" means to make someone lose confidence in trying. Since those are completely different, Discourage is the opposite of Encourage!
quests.funFact: A few encouraging words can help someone try again even after a tricky mistake!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Illuminate"? (a candle lighting up a whole room vs. clouds rolling in to dim the sky)
quests.question: Illuminate
quests.hint: Think about what a single candle does the moment you strike a match. What's the opposite of "Illuminate"?
quests.explanation: "Illuminate" means to fill with light. "Darken" means to take light away. Since those are completely different, Darken is the opposite of Illuminate!
quests.funFact: Fireflies illuminate the summer night using a glow made inside their own bodies!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Nutritious"? (a colorful plate of vegetables vs. a bag of sugary candy)
quests.question: Nutritious
quests.hint: Think about which snack would give you more energy for a whole soccer game. What's the opposite of "Nutritious"?
quests.explanation: "Nutritious" means good for your body and full of nutrients. "Unhealthy" means bad for your body if eaten too often. Since those are completely different, Unhealthy is the opposite of Nutritious!
quests.funFact: Eating something nutritious, like broccoli, helps your whole body grow strong!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Domestic"? (a pet dog curled up on the couch vs. a wolf howling in the forest)
quests.question: Domestic
quests.hint: Think about the difference between the animal sleeping on your bed and one living in a forest. What's the opposite of "Domestic"?
quests.explanation: "Domestic" means tamed and living closely with people. "Wild" means living freely in nature, untamed. Since those are completely different, Wild is the opposite of Domestic!
quests.funFact: Scientists believe every pet dog today is related to wild wolves from long ago!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Optional"? (a dessert you can choose to skip vs. homework you must turn in)
quests.question: Optional
quests.hint: Think about the part of a form marked with a little star that you must fill in. What's the opposite of "Optional"?
quests.explanation: "Optional" means something you may choose to do or not. "Required" means something you must do, no choosing. Since those are completely different, Required is the opposite of Optional!
quests.funFact: Seatbelts are required by law in cars because they save so many lives!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Plentiful"? (a lush rainforest packed with plants vs. a stretch of desert with just a few cacti)
quests.question: Plentiful
quests.hint: Think about how much plant life you'd expect in a jungle compared to a desert. What's the opposite of "Plentiful"?
quests.explanation: "Plentiful" means available in a large amount. "Sparse" means available in only a small amount. Since those are completely different, Sparse is the opposite of Plentiful!
quests.funFact: Rain is so plentiful in some rainforests that it falls almost every single day!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Cheerful"? (a sunny morning full of birdsong vs. a gray afternoon of drizzle)
quests.question: Cheerful
quests.hint: Think about how a rainy Monday can feel compared to the first day of summer break. What's the opposite of "Cheerful"?
quests.explanation: "Cheerful" means bright and full of good spirits. "Gloomy" means dull and low in spirits. Since those are completely different, Gloomy is the opposite of Cheerful!
quests.funFact: Playing your favorite upbeat song is a quick way to turn a gloomy mood cheerful!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Include"? (inviting every classmate to the party vs. leaving one name off the list)
quests.question: Include
quests.hint: Think about what a kind teacher does when picking teams for a game. What's the opposite of "Include"?
quests.explanation: "Include" means to add someone or something in. "Exclude" means to leave someone or something out. Since those are completely different, Exclude is the opposite of Include!
quests.funFact: Board games with 'house rules' often include extra players who want to join!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Authentic"? (an artist's original signed painting vs. a cheap copy sold on a street corner)
quests.question: Authentic
quests.hint: Think about what a museum expert checks for before buying a rare painting. What's the opposite of "Authentic"?
quests.explanation: "Authentic" means genuinely real, made by the true source. "Counterfeit" means a copy made to trick people into thinking it's real. Since those are completely different, Counterfeit is the opposite of Authentic!
quests.funFact: Experts use special lights and tools to spot a counterfeit painting or bill!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Enlarge"? (zooming a photo in on a phone vs. zooming a photo back out)
quests.question: Enlarge
quests.hint: Think about what a magnifying glass does to tiny print in a book. What's the opposite of "Enlarge"?
quests.explanation: "Enlarge" means to make something bigger. "Reduce" means to make something smaller. Since those are completely different, Reduce is the opposite of Enlarge!
quests.funFact: A magnifying glass can enlarge a tiny ant enough to see every leg clearly!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Grateful"? (writing a thank-you note for a gift vs. tossing a gift aside without a word)
quests.question: Grateful
quests.hint: Think about what you'd say right after opening a thoughtful present. What's the opposite of "Grateful"?
quests.explanation: "Grateful" means thankful for something you received. "Ungrateful" means not thankful for something you received. Since those are completely different, Ungrateful is the opposite of Grateful!
quests.funFact: Studies show that people who feel grateful often sleep and feel better overall!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Delighted"? (jumping for joy at a surprise gift vs. slumping after hearing the trip is cancelled)
quests.question: Delighted
quests.hint: Think about how you'd feel if your favorite show got an extra season, unexpectedly. What's the opposite of "Delighted"?
quests.explanation: "Delighted" means filled with great happiness. "Disappointed" means let down because something didn't go as hoped. Since those are completely different, Disappointed is the opposite of Delighted!
quests.funFact: Being delighted by small surprises, like a sunny day, can boost your whole mood!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Cooperate"? (two teams building one giant tower together vs. two teams racing to win separately)
quests.question: Cooperate
quests.hint: Think about what a group project asks classmates to do together. What's the opposite of "Cooperate"?
quests.explanation: "Cooperate" means to work together toward one goal. "Compete" means to try to beat each other at a goal. Since those are completely different, Compete is the opposite of Cooperate!
quests.funFact: Ant colonies cooperate so well that they can build homes far bigger than themselves!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Vague"? (fuzzy directions that could mean anywhere vs. a map with an exact marked spot)
quests.question: Vague
quests.hint: Think about the kind of instructions that leave you asking 'wait, which way?'. What's the opposite of "Vague"?
quests.explanation: "Vague" means unclear, without enough detail. "Clear" means easy to understand, with plenty of detail. Since those are completely different, Clear is the opposite of Vague!
quests.funFact: A clear, detailed map can help you find a hidden treasure much faster than a vague one!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Approve"? (a judge nodding and stamping 'accepted' vs. a judge crossing out an entry)
quests.question: Approve
quests.hint: Think about what happens to a science-fair project that meets every rule. What's the opposite of "Approve"?
quests.explanation: "Approve" means to agree that something is good enough. "Reject" means to decide that something is not good enough. Since those are completely different, Reject is the opposite of Approve!
quests.funFact: Inventors often get their first idea rejected many times before one is finally approved!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Elevate"? (a crane lifting a piano up to a window vs. workers setting it back down)
quests.question: Elevate
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what a hospital bed does when a nurse presses the up button. That describes the exact opposite of "Elevate"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: elevate means to raise something higher, and lower means to bring something down — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Adjustable desks let you elevate them so you can even work standing up!

quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: illuminate means to fill with light, and darken means to take light away — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Fireflies illuminate the summer night using a glow made inside their own bodies!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Colossal"? (a colossal dinosaur skeleton in a museum vs. a miniature toy dinosaur on a shelf)
quests.question: Colossal
quests.hint: Think about the difference in size between a real blue whale and a bathtub toy. What's the opposite of "Colossal"?
quests.explanation: "Colossal" means absolutely enormous in size. "Miniature" means extremely small in size, like a tiny model. Since those are completely different, Miniature is the opposite of Colossal!
quests.funFact: A colossal blue whale can be as long as three school buses parked end to end!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Plentiful"? (a lush rainforest packed with plants vs. a stretch of desert with just a few cacti)

quests.hint: Here's a clue: how much plant life you'd expect in a jungle compared to a desert. That describes the exact opposite of "Plentiful"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: plentiful means available in a large amount, and sparse means available in only a small amount — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Rain is so plentiful in some rainforests that it falls almost every single day!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Forward"? (a dancer stepping ahead confidently vs. a dancer stepping carefully in reverse)
quests.question: Forward
quests.hint: Think about which direction a car goes in when you shift into reverse. What's the opposite of "Forward"?
quests.explanation: "Forward" means moving in the direction you're facing. "Backward" means moving in the opposite direction you're facing. Since those are completely different, Backward is the opposite of Forward!
quests.funFact: Some talented gymnasts can walk backward on a balance beam without ever looking!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Nutritious"? (a colorful plate of vegetables vs. a bag of sugary candy)
quests.question: Nutritious
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which snack would give you more energy for a whole soccer game. That describes the exact opposite of "Nutritious"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: nutritious means good for your body and full of nutrients, and unhealthy means bad for your body if eaten too often — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Eating something nutritious, like broccoli, helps your whole body grow strong!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Reliable"? (an alarm clock that rings every single morning vs. one that skips days at random)
quests.question: Reliable
quests.hint: Think about the kind of friend who always shows up exactly when they say they will. What's the opposite of "Reliable"?
quests.explanation: "Reliable" means able to be trusted to work every time. "Unreliable" means not able to be trusted to work every time. Since those are completely different, Unreliable is the opposite of Reliable!
quests.funFact: Guide dogs are trained for years to become completely reliable helpers!
